sql: SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status
SELECT id, title, status, desk, published_at FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23']
SELECT id, kind, text, article FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull'
SELECT id, kind, text, article FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7]
SELECT id, status, body FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23']
SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox
SELECT article as art, count() as n FROM brief GROUP BY article ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT parent, count() FROM passage WHERE parent IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7] GROUP BY parent
SELECT id, ->covers->topic AS topics FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23']
SELECT id, title, status, body FROM article WHERE ->covers->topic CONTAINS topic:t1
SELECT id, kind, text, article, article.status AS art_status FROM brief WHERE kind = 't3'
SELECT id, title, status FROM article WHERE title != string::concat(desk, ' desk report ', string::replace(id, 'article:a', ''))
SELECT id, title, status FROM article WHERE title NOT CONTAINS 'desk report'
